name: RC-B10-0217/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Venezuela's "Amnesty Law", which it says failed to free political prisoners. It asks for the unconditional release of all people held for political reasons, for an end to repression, and for the European Union to keep sanctions on those responsible for human rights abuses until there is a real path to free elections.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. Parliament only states its position and demands.
- **Who it affects:** Venezuela's government, political prisoners, and European Union sanctions policy.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission and the top EU foreign affairs official for follow-up.
